chunk: Now, the proof of this is very quick. But this is a fundamental fact. The proof is the following. chunk: And we'll be abbreviating it FTC, and occasionally I'll put in a 1 here, because there will be two versions of it. But this is the one that you'll be using the most in this class. The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus says the following. It says that if f' is equal to f, so f' of x is equal to f of x, is a capital F and a little f, then the integral from a to b of f of x is equal to f of b minus f of a.
